summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, containing IFRS-based financial data, operational highlights, and forward-looking guidance. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is purely a periodic financial update.
